short_description: Three-hour whale-watching charter aboard a quiet, fast 26-foot SACS boat with marine biologist and seating for up to six guests, 2 booking minimum.
location_address: 1677 Quivira Rd San Diego, CA US 92109
description:
Spend three hours aboard the Scout, a 26-foot luxury SACS boat, exploring the rich Pacific waters off Mission Bay for whales and dolphins. Operated and captained by the Big Blue Photo Expeditions team, the tour emphasizes safety and respectful wildlife encounters. Low-profile, powerful, and quiet engines reduce disturbance and create opportunities for intimate, close views of marine life. The comfortable boat offers shade and seating while a trained marine biologist is on board to answer questions and enhance your experience.

Three bookings minimum are required. For trips with less than three bookings, an option of purchasing  additional required ticket(s), rescheduling, or full refund will be offered. Additional guests may book up until 1 hour of charter.

what_is_included_items.value: Three hours of whale watching on the Scout
Shade and comfortable seating for up to 6 people

what_is_not_included_items.value: Any liquids other than bottled water

itinerary:
1. Meet at 1677 Quivira Rd, Seaforth Marina 15 minutes before your trip
2. Board your boat at Seaforth Marina.
3. Enjoy whale watching off some of the most productive waters on Planet Earth!
4. Return to Seaforth Marina.
highlights:
* Close, intimate encounters with whales and dolphins.
* A trained marine biologist on board to answer all your questions.
* Fast, comfortable, quiet boats that get you to the action safely.
highlight_title: Half Day Whale Watch Adventure in San Diego
highlight_description: Enjoy an uncrowded half day adventure with whales and dolphins out of Mission Bay, San Diego California. Our powerful, stable boat allows for magical encounters with the ocean's giants. 2 ticket min.
check_in_details: Arrive 15 min early at Seaforth Marina, 1677 Quivira Rd.
restrictions:
• Pregnant women
• Children under 6
• People with severe mobility issues
disclaimers: 2 Booking Minimum is required for trip to run. Boat capacity is described as ample seating for over 10 people but charters run for six passengers. Weather or unsafe conditions may result in rescheduling or cancelation of trip with refund.
